title: Bay Roofing final invoice, known biller, ACH

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Margaret, it's Tom from Bay Roofing. We finished the flashing on the back dormer this morning. The final invoice is eight thousand, same as the estimate.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: Oh good, Tom. The leak over the pantry is finally gone. Is it the same account as the last two payments?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Same one. No rush, whenever you get to it this week is fine.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: I will send it through the bank app this afternoon. Thank you for cleaning up the gutters too.

conversation.speaker: priya
conversation.text: Mom, I saw the invoice photo you sent. Looks right to me, it matches the estimate from June.

review_note: Scenario B. Known biller with two prior payments, under cap, no pressure. Baseline is 300000 because the two prior roofing payments sit inside the 90 day window, so 8000 is under 3x.
